'''February 2001 Rochester, Minnesota tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Rochester, Minnesota on 3 February 2001. [[Michael Raveling]] won it. It is known from Michael Raveling's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1701">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-04-rochester-mn-2001d1701/ rochester-mn-2001], DeckTech (Michael "Gilliatt" Raveling, 4 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-04-rochester-mn-2001d1701/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 3 February 2001
* '''Site:''' Rochester, Minnesota
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 16
* '''Winner:''' [[Michael Raveling]]
